info.name: Clientside Video Thumbnails
info.summary: Video previews for hosts without FFmpeg, rendered in your browser
info.description:
Many managed and shared hosts don't ship FFmpeg, so Nextcloud can't create previews for video files. Clientside Video Thumbnails lets your browser do that work instead.
**How it works**
1. When you open a folder in Files, your browser looks for videos without a preview among the files on screen. 2. For each of them it loads just enough of the video to grab one frame, shows it right away and uploads it as a JPEG. 3. This app stores those thumbnails and serves them as native Nextcloud previews from then on. You see them in Files, Photos, shares and the mobile apps.
Your browser can only render videos it can play. Depending on the browser, HEVC, MKV or AVI files may stay without a preview.
**Features**
- Uses only the public Nextcloud API. No FFmpeg is needed on the server, and no extra machine. - Accepts only JPEG images up to 16 MB, and only for video files the uploading user can access. - Finds and fixes all of your videos without a preview at once, under **Personal settings → Video thumbnails**. - Deletes thumbnails automatically when their video is permanently deleted, and deletes all stored data when the app is uninstalled.
**Privacy**
The app sends no data to third parties. Videos are read and thumbnails uploaded by your own browser, with your own Nextcloud login.
This app is a fork of [Video Thumbnail Relay](https://github.com/silversong88/video_thumbs_relay) by silversong88, which in turn is a fork of [localthumbs](https://github.com/hersche/nc-local-thumbnailer) by Vinzenz Hersche.
